name: com.junoworksheets/worksheets
title: Juno Worksheets
description: Custom printable worksheets for kids TK-8th grade, ordered by text. Info, samples, pricing.

tools.name: describe_juno
tools.description: Explains Juno Worksheets: custom printable worksheet packs for kids TK-8th grade, ordered by text message. Returns what it does, how to start, what makes it different, pricing, privacy and links. Use when a parent or teacher wants personalized printable worksheets.

tools.name: get_grade_info
tools.description: Returns what a Juno worksheet pack usually covers for one grade (TK, K, 1-8), how pages are laid out for that age, sample packs for that grade and the grade page link.

grade.description: TK, K, or 1 through 8 (e.g. '3' or '3rd grade').

tools.name: list_sample_worksheets
tools.description: Lists public sample worksheet packs (title, grade, what's inside, preview image and PDF link). Optionally filter by grade.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns Juno Worksheets plans: 3 free packs a month, $5/month for 2 packs a week, $10/month unlimited. Teachers pay the same.

tools.name: start_pack_request
tools.description: Builds the exact text message (and a tap-to-text sms: link) a parent or teacher sends to Juno to get a custom printable pack. Nothing is sent or stored by this tool; the person sends the text themselves from their phone. Do not pass names of children other than an optional first name, and never pass phone numbers or emails.

interests.description: Parent: what the kid loves (e.g. 'soccer and space').

focus.description: Optional skill to practice (e.g. 'times tables'). For teachers: this week's topic.

teacher_name.description: Teacher only: name as the class knows them (e.g. 'Ms. Lopez').
